description: This file is a TypeScript source file implementing a Babel plugin for transforming JSX and import statements within the Playwright testing framework. It collects JSX component usages, manages import references, and modifies the AST accordingly.

classes.name: ImportInfo
classes.description: Type representing information about an import, including its ID, filename, source, and remote name.

methods.name: importInfo
methods.description: Generates an ImportInfo object for a given import specifier, constructing a unique ID and extracting remote name if available.

methods.name: collectJsxComponentUsages
methods.description: Traverses a node to collect all JSX component usage names.
